issues.title: 5.3 - Perception of other force (asset name)
issues.body:
As a < Player >, I want < to record the name of a contact > so that < I can refer to it by name >.

A user pointed out that it was wrong for players to see the name for *Grey* asset.  But, as the game progresses, they may learn the name of assets, either through simulated intelligence briefings, them getting close enough to ID it, or other.

So, in the wargame definition, each asset should have a  unique `contact number`, something like `T032`.  The number won't give away which force the asset belongs to.   Players of other forces will only see the contact number.  But, in the **Perception** dialog, they will be able to enter a name.  So, this isn't the actual name - it's just their perception.  Once a player has a perceived name for an asset from another force, we display that name, not the contact number.

A player can clear the name in the popup, which will make Serge switch back to displaying the contact number.

# Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Game running, logged in as player
- [ ] Hover over an asset from another force, see it's contact number
- [ ] Click on asset, popup dialog shows contact number, but has text field for `Name`
- [ ] Player enters name, and presses `Save`
- [ ] The new name is now displayed when hovering over that counter

# UX
Tiny bit of ux, please @clenoble .

issues.title: Messages don't collapse on `Submit for review`
issues.body:
In the new Collaborative Editing (`Blue COA 2`) when players Submit a message for review, the message should collapse.

Actually, this may be a feature we've forgotten to implement in the new `react-data-table` component.

I can see that `toggleRow` is working when we click on a table row.  But we're unable to force the message to close once it has been acted upon.
